about_the_game:
About This Game

In the fast-paced urban life, have you ever longed to escape the noise and find a moment of peace? Shepherd Planet is an ultra-casual, heartwarming game tailor-made for fans of farm simulators. Here, you'll spend cozy moments with adorable animal friends and immerse yourself in a serene shepherding experience.

The game features two carefully crafted gameplay modes, catering to both challenge seekers and relaxation lovers alike.

🐑 Mode 1: Fun Challenges & Surprises to Unlock

In Challenge Mode, every level brings fresh excitement and unique tasks! Your goal is to herd a specific number of sheep into the pen within a limited time. The timer bar in the lower left corner keeps you on your toes, adding a sense of urgency and thrill to your herding adventure. As you progress, the difficulty increases, and new dog breeds become available. Who knows—you might even spot a pup that looks just like your own furry friend!

🌿 Mode 2: Leisurely Roaming, Follow Your Heart

If you yearn for the tranquility of countryside life, don’t miss out on the Casual Mode. On the vast open plains, you can herd at your own pace and watch your flock grow. Lie back on the soft grass and gaze at the sky, watching the clouds drift by and stars twinkle above. You can even chase playful bunnies or frolic with fluttering butterflies—fully immersing yourself in nature’s embrace.

Thoughtfully, the number of sheep in Casual Mode dynamically adjusts based on your device's performance, ensuring a smooth and relaxing experience for all players.

Whether you're seeking exciting challenges or a peaceful retreat for your soul, Shepherd Planet offers a pastoral dream come true.

Join us now and begin your soothing shepherding journey!
